videos.desc: In a mountain village field a young archer holds a tall bamboo bow at full draw, one eye down the shaft, holding steady on a distant hay bale for most of the clip before he lets the arrow go and follows its flight.

In a pottery studio a couple smash a cloth-wrapped stack of plates with a mallet, then a man in gloves picks the flat shards out of the cloth and presses them one by one into a clay square, building a flower pattern; at the end the pair hold up the finished tiled panel.
In a wood-paneled game room, a red-haired woman squints, aims and throws a turquoise dart; it flies across the room and sticks near the bullseye of the dartboard, and she cheers with her friends.

A calm hand-painted mountain lake lies still until a splash breaks the surface and a swimmer in a teal cap and goggles bursts up out of the water. She lifts her goggles, grins and throws her arms up in triumph.

Top-down view of hands wrapping lollipops in pink and cream paper to look like flower buds, drawing a smiley face on one, then wrapping the whole bunch in white paper and tying a ribbon to finish a mini candy bouquet.

In a smoky blue-lit studio with a drum kit, amps and graffiti, a young woman in a crop top and baggy jeans performs for the camera: she sings, dances, points at the lens, plays the drums and poses on a leather couch like in a music video.

In an autumn forest a man and a woman in camouflage examine fresh deer tracks in the mud with their hunting dog, sneak behind a mossy log, scan the trees with binoculars and excitedly spot a stag standing among the leaves.
videos.said: Fresh this morning. There, look at her.

videos.desc: At golden hour in a narrow cobblestone street, a young woman directs a man posing against a sunlit wall, shoots him with a large camera, then the two lean over the camera screen together, pointing at the shots and celebrating the best one.
videos.said: Three, two, hold! That one! That one!

videos.desc: On a black-sand beach an animated girl draws a big spiral in the wet sand with a stick. A wave rolls in and the whole drawing vanishes without a trace; she gasps, draws it again, and the sea erases it again.

Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.

A head-mounted point-of-view shot from a kitesurfer riding on a shallow lagoon at sunset. Two bare forearms reach forward into the frame and both hands close around the horizontal control bar of a kite, the lines running up out of shot. The orange sun sits low over a line of palm trees on the far shore and other kites are visible as small shapes in the purple sky. The rider leans back, the board carves and white spray sheets up across the lens, and the shot ends with the red kite canopy overhead as he skims across the water.

An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.

Inside the cramped white cabin of a small aeroplane, several people in swimwear and parachute rigs shuffle barefoot towards the open door. The shot cuts outside: two of them are hanging from the wing strut under the plane's long wing, high above a coastline, with the landing wheel beside them. They hold the strut with both hands, dangling in the wind, then let go one after the other and drop away. The camera stays with the plane, and the frame is filled by the underside of the wing with the blue sea, the white surf line and the flat coastal city far below.

Filmed from inside the open door of a small plane flying high above a turquoise coral reef. A woman in a white and blue jumpsuit and harness hangs from the wing strut outside the plane, laughing, her legs swinging free in the open air. She swings under the wing, hangs upside down, and then lets go and drops away from the plane, shrinking to a tiny figure against the blue water far below.

A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.

In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.

Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.

A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.

A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.

A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.

A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.

A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.

A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.

An orchestra rehearsal in a grand hall with tall windows, globe lamps and a golden laurel frieze. A young conductor in a black shirt stands on a wooden podium with his baton raised, then lowers his arm and steps down, frowning at an empty chair: a cello leans against it with no one there to play it. A young woman with a violin, a young woman and a young man with a violin sit in a row and look at the empty seat too. The cello's bow lies on the parquet floor in front of the chair.

In an indoor swimming pool with tall sunlit windows, the view starts close on the bare feet and legs of a young woman standing on a diving board and pulls back to show her whole body. She has short bleached hair and a grey swimsuit. She bends her knees, swings her arms back, then straightens and spreads her arms, ready to jump, at the very end of the board. Wet footprints mark the board, and far below a coach in black and swimmers at the edge look up from the blue water with red and white lane ropes.

At a bright record fair in a hall with tall windows, a young woman with long dark curls, in an olive jacket, beige knit top and jeans, kneels by wooden crates full of vinyl records with a thick stack under one arm. She eagerly lifts a record with an orange label in a crate, then lets go of it and hugs her stack of records to her chest. A chalkboard price sign stands on the crates. Behind her people browse the stalls: a man with headphones, a stallholder with a box and a young man lowering his raised arm.

In a retro bowling alley with teal walls, red panels and neon lights, a young woman with a long blonde braid, in a red cropped jacket and cream trousers, throws both arms up in celebration as her ball crashes into the white pins at the end of the shiny wooden lane and knocks them down. In the foreground another person's arm points down the lane. Then she lowers her arms, turns around and looks back with an open mouth and a surprised smile.

On a lit-up disco floor of bright pink, orange and blue squares, a young woman in a gold sequin crop top and white flared trousers dances close up with her arms raised. As the view moves back, four young women in the same gold tops, white trousers and gold heels appear, but their routine has fallen apart: each one moves in a different direction and at a different moment, one throws her arms up, one reaches sideways and one stands still. A mirror ball and a ring of silver spotlights hang above.

In clear blue sea, a young woman with long dark hair, in a blue bikini top, black board shorts and fins, floats upright beside a rope with a weight hanging from it and slowly blows a long stream of silver bubbles from her mouth that rise toward the bright rippling surface. Her eyes close, her fins move gently and she brings one hand to her chest. A single fish swims past on the right, and a pale sandy seabed lies below her in the deep blue water.

Three young friends play cards at a table on a moving train, fields passing outside the window. A young woman with long dark hair, in a mustard top and wide jeans, throws one arm up in triumph and laughs, then puts her hand back on the table. Across from her a young man in a navy shirt holds a fan of cards and rolls his eyes up. A young woman with a red ponytail, in a green T-shirt, stands at the table holding her cards. Paper coffee cups and a pile of cards sit on the table, and a brown and white spaniel lies underneath.

In a bright office with big windows, pendant lamps and potted plants, three young colleagues play a wooden block-stacking game. A young man in a blue shirt pulls a block out of the middle of the tall tower, which wobbles and leans, then settles upright again. He holds up the block and grins. A young man in a green T-shirt crouches and holds the base steady on a book, and a young woman in a maroon jumper gasps with her mouth open and her hands raised. Coffee mugs and pens lie on the table in front.
